look: Ash Thunderbird, a S-rank GKOM variant from the Obsidian Talons family: firestorm thunderbird with white-hot crystal plumage and lightning in its wake. Family anatomy: raptor birds whose feathers harden into knapped obsidian blades. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: a near-complete GKOM crystal hide with thin bare seams; the crystals are glossy black obsidian with ember edges. Element Fire: ember red, orange and gold accents, dramatic sweeping embers, flame ribbons and heat shimmer
